'''Anirban Pathak''' is an Indian physicist, professor, and the Head of the Department of Physics and Materials Science & Engineering at the [[Jaypee Institute of Information Technology]] (JIIT), Noida.<ref name="jiit_profile">{{cite web|url=https://www.jiit.ac.in/prof-anirban-pathak|title=Prof Anirban Pathak|website=JIIT|access-date=2024-08-01}}</ref> He has worked in quantum optics, quantum information, and quantum cryptography. He is a fellow of The [[National Academy of Sciences, India]] (NASI),<ref name="nasi" /> the [[Optical Society of India]] (OSI),<ref name="osi" /> and the [[Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers]] (IETE).<ref name="jiit_profile" /> He is also the 2017 recipient of the [[Om Prakash Bhasin Award]] in the field of Electronics & Information Technology.<ref name="opbhasin" />

== Education ==
Anirban Pathak received his Ph.D. in Physics from [[Visva-Bharati University]], Santiniketan. Following his doctoral studies, he was a post-doctoral research fellow at the [[Free University of Berlin]], Germany.<ref name="jiit_profile"/>

== Career ==
He joined the [[Jaypee Institute of Information Technology]], Noida, in 2002. He is currently a professor and the Head of the Department of Physics and Materials Science & Engineering.<ref name="jiit_profile"/> He also heads the Centre for Quantum Science and Technology at JIIT.<ref name="collegedunia">{{cite interview|url=https://collegedunia.com/news/c-25953-interview-prof-anirban-pathak-head-of-department-dept-of-physics-and-material-science-engineering-at-jaypee-institute-of-information-technology-noida|title=Interview: Prof. Anirban Pathak, Head of Department, Dept. of Physics and Material Science & Engineering at Jaypee Institute of Information Technology, Noida|website=Collegedunia|date=2020-05-04|access-date=2024-08-01}}</ref>

== Research ==
His research focuses on quantum optics, quantum information theory, quantum cryptography, and the applications of non-classical light. He has published over 170 research papers in peer-reviewed journals and has an h-index of 38 as of August 2024.<ref name="scholar">{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.co.in/citations?user=fQ54OcoAAAAJ|title=Anirban Pathak|website=Google Scholar|access-date=2024-08-01}}</ref>

=== Academic community involvement ===
He serves as an Associate Editor for the journal ''Quantum Information Processing'' (Springer Nature).<ref name="associate editor">{{cite web|url=https://link.springer.com/journal/11128/editorial-board|title=Quantum Information Processing - Editorial Board|website=Springer Nature Link|access-date=2024-08-01}}</ref>
He is also on the editorial board of ''Quantum Review Letters'' (KeAi Publishing).<ref name="keai">{{cite web|url=https://www.keaipublishing.com/en/journals/quantum-review-letters/editorial-board|title=Quantum Review Letters - Editorial Board|website=KeAi Publishing|access-date=2024-08-01}}</ref>

In a 2020 interview with ''[[Mint (newspaper)|Mint]]'', he commented on the state of quantum research in India, highlighting the need for increased investment and focus to compete globally in the field.<ref name="mint">{{cite web |last=Pahwa |first=Timsy |date=2020-01-14 |title=Why India is falling behind in the Y2Q race |url=https://www.livemint.com/technology/tech-news/why-india-is-falling-behind-in-the-y2q-race-11579018170008.html |website=Mint |access-date=2024-08-01}}</ref>
